mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a cool 68 degrees with overcast skies by the Verona Public Library. Tonight, we have a first quarter moon and the ISS will be visible starting at 7:37 PM, appearing in the West Northwest over Cross Plains and moving toward the Northeast by the Home Depot. The overnight low will hit 56 degrees with no rain predicted.
City Hall is currently focused on development projects and the new comprehensive plan, while the Police Department is actively recruiting new patrol officers to join their team.
We have plenty happening locally, including Yoga at Insight Wellness today, Hop Haus Trivia this Thursday, and the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival this Friday and Saturday.

A noteworthy call occurred on September 5 when officers investigated multiple reports of cheese slices left on windshields throughout town, which they identified as a social media trend known as the Dairy Dare.
The Culver's of Verona is closed today for a scheduled remodel, so there is no flavor of the day to report at this time.
